config.seed_note: same K populations on every day; a share only rescales them
config.planning_inputs: yesterday_forecast_inputs (previous CST day, target month prices)

windows.generic: earliest U{0..20}, length U{3..12}, deadline min(24, earliest+length)

population.scaling: sum(max_mw) = share_pct/100 x day's actual peak demand (energy scaled alike)

config.definition: Predicted savings = sum_i [E(all default) - E(bid i runs the strategy alone, others default)]; realized = E(all default) - E(all run the strategy together); gap = predicted - realized; gap % = 100 x gap / predicted (only where predicted > 0). Every E is fossil CO2 (t) from the calibrated (M3) simulator on the day's actual EIA-930 inputs; plans use yesterday-as-forecast inputs. GO if the primary (strategy 3, independent-marginal) gap % (mean over K draws of per-draw gap %) >= 10% at some share <= 20% on >= 4 of 7 days.
config.decision_aggregation: mean over K draws of per-draw gap %, over draws with predicted > 0 (n_defined); ratio of means reported only as a robustness check

verdict.rule: primary gap % >= 10.0% at some share <= 20.0% on >= 4 of 7 days
